title: Rerank scaling and reliability: timeouts, circuit breakers, fallbacks, and regional routing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Harden the reranking endpoint to support 5x concurrent load, reduce tail latency, and avoid cascading failures in multi-region deployments. Scope covers: adaptive request timeouts, per-host and global circuit breakers, a lightweight fallback path that returns a cheaper approximate rerank, and policy-driven regional routing to prefer local replicas and failover to other regions when capacity or health degrades. This ticket coordinates infra changes, API contracts, monitoring, and a staged rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint sustains 5x baseline QPS in perf tests while 95th percentile <= 300ms for small rerank jobs (<= 64 candidates)
Circuit breaker trips isolate unhealthy hosts without service-wide degradation in chaos tests
Fallback path returns results within 200ms and degrades ranking quality gracefully (documented score delta)
Regional routing prefers same-region replicas and fails over in under 150ms when health checks trigger
No customer-facing 5xx spike during canary rollout; automated rollback on error budget breach
Monitoring dashboards and alerts deployed: CB open rate, fallback rate, per-region p95/p99 latency, error budget burn
implementation_notes: Add adaptive timeout logic: base timeout by candidate count + dynamic multiplier based on recent latency windows
Introduce two-level circuit breakers: host-level short window (5s) and service-level longer window (60s) with configurable thresholds
Fallback implementation: lightweight approximate reranker using smaller embedding model and lower token budget — used when CB open or timeout exceeded
Regional routing: enhance smart router to include rerank-capable replica tags and prefer local region, with async capacity probe before cross-region failover
Data plane changes must be backward compatible with existing rerank API; use header flags to enable new behavior per-route
Trade-offs: aggressive fallbacks reduce quality but protect availability; will tune via experiments and customer-facing SLAs
rollout_plan: Unit and integration tests + synthetic perf harness (local) — week 1
Internal canary (dev org) with fallback enabled — 48h
Progressive canary: 1% production traffic -> 5% -> 20% over 3 days with automated health gates
Regional canaries: enable in us-west-2 first, observe inter-region failover behavior, then eu-west-1
Full production enablement with monitoring and immediate rollback playbook if error budget > 2% in 1h
monitoring_and_alerts: Alert: rerank_cb_open_rate > 1% for 5m in any region => PagerDuty
Alert: fallback_rate > 5% for 10m => Oncall + PM notification
Alert: error_budget_burn > 50% in 1h => automatic traffic throttling and rollback
SLOs: availability 99.9% / latency p95 <= 350ms for typical workloads
